summary: Iter 152: Validated Manifestation in-app YouTube modal, 7-stage wrapping, admin Manifestation Content editor, admin Test OTP buttons, and Life Mirror rename. Wrote pytest suite (8/8 PASS) covering: public framework returns 7 stages; admin framework requires auth (401); admin GET/PUT/RESET round-trip with override flag flip and public reflection; PUT 400 on empty list; collab admin/otp-test requires admin and accepts email + whatsapp from super-admin. Frontend smoke-test (web preview, super-admin login) confirmed: (a) /admin/manifestation-content loads with JSON editor pre-filled, DEFAULT badge visible, Save / Reset buttons rendered; (b) /admin/collab-auth shows the new 'Test delivery' card with input + Test Email OTP + Test WhatsApp OTP buttons; (c) /tools/goal-manifestation overview wraps the 7 CAB-FAME stage pills across 2 rows with full readable names (no horizontal scroll/truncation); (d) /tools/public-pulse header now reads 'Life Mirror' (string 'Public Pulse' no longer present on that screen). InAppVideoModal wiring verified by code review: goal-manifestation.tsx L243-248 invokes setVideoModal for youtube|youtu.be|vimeo|.mp4/.webm/.ogg/.mov links and falls back to Linking.openURL otherwise; InAppVideoModal.tsx web path renders a real <iframe src='https://www.youtube.com/embed/<id>'> inside a Modal overlay with a close button — keeps user in-app.
action_items: Minor (non-blocking): /app/frontend/src/utils/routeVoiceParser.ts L233 still has label 'Public Pulse'. Voice/parser-only label — won't show as a screen title but consider updating to 'Life Mirror' for voice navigation consistency.
Pre-existing (acknowledged in request, not in scope): GET /api/acm/health → 404, and passlib bcrypt __about__ warning. No action.
critical_code_review_comments: InAppVideoModal correctly uses iframe on web (Platform.OS==='web') and react-native-webview on native — same pattern as EFT MediaEmbed.
Admin manifestation override stored in db.app_config under key cabfame_framework with idempotent reset; _effective_framework() correctly falls back to built-in CABFAME_STAGES.
PUT validates stage_number/name/steps presence and rejects empty list (400) — verified by test.
collab-auth Test delivery section disables both OTP buttons while one is in-flight (testBusy state) — good UX.
seed_data_creation: None. PUT/RESET test self-cleans by deleting the cabfame_framework override at end via /admin/framework/reset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login endpoint /api/auth/login returns session_token (not access_token) — use Bearer of session_token for admin routes. EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is the public base URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Manifestation admin override key is db.app_config key='cabfame_framework'. Iteration 152 features all green; the in-app YouTube modal is verified by code-path + DOM iframe render (cannot autoplay YouTube on CI but the iframe element does appear when ytlink is tapped after expanding step 1.6).
